I found Bruno after Insomnia adopted the Postman strategy of being cloud first, with a disastrous migration. I've been using it for a while and I really like the offline first + git collaboration aspect of it. Only missing Websockets functionality at the moment.
I've replaced Postman with Bruno (desktop app), works great so far! It's nice to put the collection folder in git so I can collaborate with others and commit the changes to the repo.
bruno seems really easy and good, but then.. it doesn't support cookies..
Doesn't seem to support advanced stuff like GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets...
But can it handle oauth2? I had to write a httpie script recently just to test an oauth2 api.
I'm tired of Postman freezing when sending JSONs over a MB in size... I hope Bruno works better in that regard.
Having version controlled api collections is a good enough idea that it makes all other ideas seem a little crazy.
